outcome: mis-selection ships the selection layer end to end. A versioned repo-owned Mapping Master is now the single authority for plant aliases, the MIS format and the (cost centre, GL) to MIS-line mapping, with the nine unresolved DUB triples held in an explicit unmapped-GL bucket rather than inferred or dropped. Selection narrows the governed path rather than forking it - the master's resolved triples filter the Actual side before the (gl_code, month) roll-up - and two governed routes expose it. An authenticated user opens MIS Reports, picks Agriculture / Nursery / DUB and a period, presses Generate, and sees the DUB nursery slice from real SAP data: the resolved scope, the totals, the governed GL rows, and the unmapped-GL bucket as a reviewable list carrying an Actual and a Budget amount per GL with the reason each one is unmapped. That list is the artifact that goes to Srihari to get the authoritative mapping back.
title: Selection + mapping master
